title: CosmoMail
brief: Priya needs a crisp, leadership-ready summary of the Atlas migration before Thursday's review. Use Cosmo to read the thread and answer questions (status, blockers, budget, timeline risk), then reply to Priya with a scannable bullet summary.

assistant.systemPromptExtra: Help the learner interrogate the thread for facts (dates, owners, budget, blockers) and produce a concise, executive-ready summary. Encourage them to verify details against the emails.
assistant.initialMessage: Ask me anything about this thread — status, the blocker, budget, or whether Aug 14 still holds.

rubricHints.notes: Reward accurate use of thread facts: 7/12 services migrated, auth service blocked by a deprecated token signing scheme (Sam building a shim, ~5 business days), August 14 go-live at risk, budget $85k approved / $22k spent. Reward a scannable, bullet-form summary and effective use of Cosmo for Q&A. Penalize invented facts.
